content: प्रसाधनम् .²1 Accomplishing, effecting, bringing about. .²2 Setting in order, arranging. .²3 Decorating, ornamenting, embellishing; toilet, dress; ध्रियते कुसुमप्रसाधनं तव तच्चारु वपुर्न दृश्यते <ls>Ku. 4. 18</ls>. .²4 A decoration, ornament, means of decoration or ornament; भूतार्थशोभाह्रियमाणनेत्राः प्रसाधने संनिहितेऽपि नार्यः <ls>Ku. 7. 13</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 7.">30</ls>. .{@-नः, -नम्, -नी@} A comb.
